notes.title: Canadian Game Sale
notes.content: [p]We're excited to announce that My Tiny Park is participating in the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45548675/sale/CanadiansGamesSale"]Canadian Game Sale[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p]Obviously, the game isn't released so there's no discounts on our end, however we're being showcased alongside a TON of amazing Canadian-made games and we couldn't be more thrilled! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/20bef361278e6d2b997080e4cc5072ffb63eda16.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]So be sure to check out all the amazing home-grown devs during the event! There's over 300 games involved so you might just find your next favorite![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Indie Assemble
notes.content:
[h1][b]Exciting News! [/b][/h1]

My Tiny Park is participating in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IndieAssemble]Indie Assemble[/url] Steam Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538738/1a0c7d25e629563e3721fccc82cc1576f8ad3ebd.png[/img]

Check out over 1000 games from over 600 countries in this amazing collection of games from all over the world! We're so excited to be a part of this global celebration of incredible games from over 600 Indie developers! 

Check it out from May 5th - 11th, 2025!
